reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: param = request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to response.getWriter().println(param) at line 22 without HTML encoding. The principal check (p.getName().startsWith('svc_')) is a conditional guard but does not sanitize the user input. Resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input from the BenchmarkTest parameter. Direct echo of unsanitized user input to HTML response is a classic XSS vulnerability.
